description: This source file contains unit tests for the XCast plugin using Google Test framework. It tests various plugin methods such as getApiVersionNumber, getProtocolVersion, set/getFriendlyName, set/getStandbyBehavior, app state change handling, application registration/unregistration, and event subscriptions for application lifecycle events.

classes.name: XCastPreLoad
classes.description: Test fixture that sets up a mock for RfcApi and ensures cleanup, used as base for other test classes.

classes.name: XCastTest
classes.description: Test fixture that initializes the plugin, handler, connection, and basic test setup.

classes.name: XCastDsTest
classes.description: Extends XCastTest, provides mock setup for rtObjectBase.

classes.name: XCastInitializedTest
classes.description: Extended fixture with mocks for Iarm, rtObjectBase, rtObjectRef, floating functions, and mocked event handlers; sets up plugin state for tests.

classes.name: XCastInitializedEventTest
classes.description: Further fixture that initializes event subscriptions and plugin state, used for testing event-related functionalities.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Tests that core methods are registered and available in the plugin's handler.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Tests the 'getApiVersionNumber' method returns the expected response.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Tests the 'getProtocolVersion' method returns the expected version string.

methods.name: getsetFriendlyName
methods.description: Tests setting and getting the friendly name property.

methods.name: getsetStandbyBehavoir
methods.description: Tests setting and getting the standby behavior property.

methods.name: onApplicationStateChanged
methods.description: Simulates application state change and verifies the expected set operations.

methods.name: getProtocolVersionInitialized
methods.description: Tests the response of 'getProtocolVersion' when called in the initialized state.

methods.name: unregisterApplications
methods.description: Tests unregistering applications and verifies the expected response.

methods.name: unRegisterAllApplications
methods.description: Tests the unregistering of multiple applications, confirms calls to pushBack and set.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Tests registration of applications, verifying the pushBack calls and set operations.

methods.name: onApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of application hide requests via event subscription.

methods.name: onApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of application state request events.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of application launch request events.

methods.name: onApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of application resume request events.

methods.name: onApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of application stop request events.
